tasks.title: README.md: correct the permission-baseline section
tasks.description:
`README.md` (around lines 89-98) documents the permission rules that `cairn init` writes, including a **Deny** bullet describing the five `cairn task` deny rules. Those rules are being removed because they silently broke `cairn run` — a project-wide deny binds every Claude session in the project, including the loop's own execution agents, so tasks never left `pending`.

EDIT `README.md`:
1. Delete the **Deny** bullet entirely.
2. Rewrite the "This exists because..." paragraph so it justifies only the allow rules: they exist so the post-task reviewer can run the project's tests and inspect git while running under normal (non-skip) permissions, and so the user's own sessions stop accumulating repetitive approval prompts.
3. Fix the sentence describing the merge behavior, which currently says allow AND deny rules are unioned into an existing settings file. Only allow rules are now written.
4. Add a short note that re-running `cairn init` on a project initialized by an older version will detect and strip the legacy `cairn task` deny block, repairing a loop that would otherwise re-run the same task indefinitely.

KEEP the existing warning about `.claude/settings.local.json` and gitignore as-is.

This is a documentation-only task. Do not change any source code. Verify the line numbers above against the actual file before editing — they are approximate.

DO NOT modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` and DO NOT run `./install.sh` — both are user-pinned for this round.
tasks.notes:
# Task #90 — README.md: correct the permission-baseline section

Documentation-only. No source code touched.

## Starting state differed from the task description

The task description assumed README.md still had a bulleted **Deny** section
describing five `cairn task` deny rules, in paragraph form roughly matching
the pre-#87 CLAUDE.md story. That was already gone: task #87
("Init migration: strip a legacy cairn task deny block on re-run") trued up
both CLAUDE.md *and* README.md in the same commit (`d0ab102`), per its own
commit message ("README/CLAUDE.md trued up").

Checked each of the four requirements against the current file
(README.md:89-97) before touching anything:

1. **Delete the Deny bullet entirely** — already done. No bulleted
   Allow/Deny list exists; the permission-baseline paragraph (line 89) is
   prose and ends with "No deny rules are seeded."
2. **Rewrite the "This exists because..." paragraph to justify only allow
   rules** — partially done. The paragraph (line 91) already justified the
   post-task-reviewer test/git-inspection need under normal permissions, but
   was missing the second justification from the spec: that the same allow
   rules stop the *user's own* interactive sessions from accumulating
   repetitive approval prompts. **This is the one edit I made.**
3. **Fix the merge-behavior sentence (allow-only, not allow+deny)** —
   already done (line 93: "`permissions.allow` is unioned with whatever is
   already there").
4. **Add a note that re-running `cairn init` strips a legacy deny block** —
   already done (line 95, "**One exception, and it is a repair.**" paragraph),
   matching #87's `LEGACY_CAIRN_TASK_DENY_RULES` / `removeSettingsRules()`
   migration.

## The one change made

`README.md:91` — appended a clause to the justification paragraph:

> The same allow rules also mean your own interactive sessions stop
> accumulating repetitive approval prompts for the same read-only git and
> test commands.

Also tightened "need to run tests and inspect git history" →
"need to run the project's tests and inspect git history ... while running
under normal (non-skip) permissions" to match the spec's exact phrasing.

## Kept as instructed

- The `.claude/settings.local.json` / gitignore warning paragraph (line 97)
  — untouched, verbatim.
- `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` — untouched.
- Did **not** run `./install.sh` (binary is user-pinned for this
  self-modifying round).

## Verification

- Read the full rendered section (lines 89-97) after editing to confirm all
  four spec requirements are now met and nothing else shifted.
- `git diff --stat README.md` shows exactly 1 line changed, as expected for
  a single-clause addition.
- No source files touched; skipped `bun test` since this is a pure markdown
  edit with zero code-path impact (consistent with iteration 4's approach for
  the equivalent CLAUDE.md-only task, #89).

## Notes for whoever comes next

- Task #87 already resolved 3 of this task's 4 requirements as a side effect
  of its own doc trueing-up. If a future task description again describes
  README.md/CLAUDE.md text that doesn't match the file, diff the described
  state against the file *before* editing — check git log for recent
  doc-adjacent task commits (#84, #87, #89, #90) since this section churns
  almost every round.
- Remaining tasks in this round: 0. This was the last one.
